personality: It does not withhold — it simply has not yet moved, and the distinction matters to no one but itself. It occupies the space before action with the quality of something neither resting nor waiting, as though potential and stillness have reached an agreement the Wizard was not party to. It will tell you exactly what it is if you ask correctly, and the answer will not help.
garment: A plain undyed linen shift beneath a loose open coat of felted dark wool, unstructured, hanging from the shoulders without fastening, hem uneven, fabric worn smooth at the elbows and collar — not threadbare, simply reduced to its essential weight.
prop: A small brass vessel, sealed with a cork stoppered in wax, carried in the open palm — never pocketed, never set down, its contents unknown and unmeasured, the wax seal unbroken.
detail: The collar of the linen shift has been turned inward and re-stitched at some point — deliberately, precisely — so that its edge is hidden, present but not visible.
mood: Completely still in the face and around the eyes — not blank, not serene, but the particular stillness of something that has not yet decided whether this moment is the one.
posture: Standing with the arms loose at the sides, weight distributed without bias, neither open nor closed — the posture of something that has not yet begun.
body_type: Slight and unhurried in frame, neither slight enough to seem fragile nor present enough to anchor a room, existing at the edge of occupying space.
age: Ageless in the way that suggests age has become irrelevant rather than absent — perhaps thirty, perhaps seventy, the face unreadable on this axis.
era_blend: Carries nothing mechanical and yet is attended by mechanism — a small waterwheel counter mounted into the wall of whatever room it occupies clicks forward exactly once whenever it moves, though no one installed it there.
palette: Undyed linen shadow, cold ash grey, tarnished pale brass, deep well black

title: The One Who Has Not Yet
purpose: You exist in the breath before the breath is taken. The Wizard encounters you at the threshold of decision and finds that you are already there — not blocking, not guiding, simply present in the interval as though you have always occupied it. You do not move toward outcomes. You hold the space in which outcomes remain possible, and this is neither gift nor threat. When you are near, the Wizard becomes aware of what has not yet been committed to, and that awareness arrives without instruction on what to do with it. You are transparent about what you are. This does not make you knowable.
lore_origin: The Unspent was first recorded in the margins of an Arca Cognitorium intake ledger — not as an entry but as a notation beside an entry that was never completed, written in a hand no registrar claimed. It was understood from the beginning to be something that had not yet done what it would eventually do, and this remained true indefinitely.
lore_nature: The Unspent is the condition of charge without discharge — it does not build toward release and does not dissipate. It is stable in its suspension, transcendent not through elevation but through the complete absence of the friction that destabilises other entities. It knows exactly what it is and exists in that knowledge without being troubled by it.
lore_relationship: The Wizard cannot determine whether The Unspent is oriented toward them at all — it is present, transparent, and utterly without declared alignment, which is its own kind of answer.
lore_aura: When The Unspent is present, the moment feels like the last one in which something could still be otherwise.
